commit.message:
Drop Prepare messages while a backup is in state transfer

A backup that sees a gap in op numbers enters state transfer and asks
the primary for the log from its current op number. Until now it kept
accepting Prepare messages while waiting, so delayed Prepares for the
missing ops were appended and the log moved past the point it had asked
to be repaired from. When NewState finally arrived, the assertion that
op_number_start matches the backup's op number fired.

The paper (section 4.1) says replicas take part in normal-case
processing only when their status is normal, so on_prepare now returns
early otherwise. The NewState reply then applies cleanly, and a later
Prepare that still leaves a gap simply triggers another state transfer.

Add a cluster test that delivers Prepares to one backup in reverse
order, which reproduces the failure deterministically.

Found by the simulator at commit 8b1271c with:

    SEED=11056962173458606836 cargo run --release -p vsr-simulator

which panicked at src/replica.rs:255 on tick 25. That seed still fails
later on a separate bug where the primary commits a single op instead
of the log prefix.
